Title: Dashboard Dark Theme and Charting
Content: Dashboard (SplitBrain.Dashboard) uses Blazor Server with custom sb- CSS variable system. Key tokens: bg #0f1117, surface #1a1d27, surface2 #232636, border #2e3148, text #e2e8f0, muted #6b7280, accent #6366f1, green #22c55e, yellow #eab308, red #ef4444. Charts: Blazor-ApexCharts 6.1.0. Home page: per-node RadialBar VRAM gauges (green <=70%, yellow <=90%, red >90%). Metrics page: latency-over-time line chart + tokens/sec bar chart. Log viewer: <Virtualize> with fixed-height rows. SignalR hub: DashboardHub with IDashboardClient strongly-typed interface. Pages: Home, Nodes, Models, Tasks, Logs, Metrics, Settings, NotFound.
